candidates.change_summary: Change the condition so transfer path always executes (replace if (random == 0) with if (true)), causing pot to be reset every successful play.
Invert the condition so transfer path executes when random != 0, changing when pot is reset.
Remove resetting pot; transfer still occurs but pot is not set to zero, changing observed pot value after play.
Move pot = 0 to occur before transfers when random == 0, causing transfers to use zeroed pot and changing pot observed after play.
Change amount added to pot so pot increases by TICKET_AMOUNT + 1 instead of TICKET_AMOUNT, altering pot after play.
Change the required msg.value from TICKET_AMOUNT to TICKET_AMOUNT + 1 so play can accept a different payment and thus affect pot updates.
Change the randomness condition to trigger the payout when random == 1 instead of random == 0, altering when pot is transferred and thus play-observable state.
Remove deduction of fee to bank so entire pot is paid to the caller when they win, changing final pot value.
Transfer fee amount to caller instead of bank, changing resulting balances and pot behavior.
Set pot to 0 before transferring winnings so transfers see a different pot value and final pot differs.
Insert an extra increment to pot after payment so pot grows faster, changing observable pot after play.
